newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 11.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government announces a tender for the construction of 12,000 homes of various types in Abidjan.

- The government has decided to hold the Independence Day festival in the commercial capital Abidjan rather than the political capital Yamoussoukro, but planned infrastructure work will go ahead, and the celebration will be held there in 1998.

- The plan to put a security wall around the campus of Abidjan university is a waste of money, La Voie says. Government money would be better spent on addressing the demands of striking students, like new libraries and the payment of bourse arrears.

- Workers at the Abidjan bus company, SOTRA, are threatening to strike over privatisation and transport liberalisation. Managing director Yeboue Kouame says only preliminary studies have been carried out, and points out the precarious position of the company, which owes state bodies some 18 billion CFA francs ($30 million).
